name: foreign viewer click: hidden rows stepped through
why: Invisible here, recorded as such: runFilter() takes the rows it hides OUT of the tbody, so a filtered single table has no display:none row for the guard to skip; the spec still pins that Shift+→ goes to the next row the filter left. The guard is for rows hidden in place (a collapsed or switched view).

name: foreign viewer click: not installed on springsteenlyrics.com
why: _slPrepareLivePage() installs the click; without it a cover click follows the link.

name: foreign viewer click: on the document instead of the window
why: Invisible here, recorded as such: _fiInstall() runs at page preparation, before initNavigationGuard() arms after a render, so on the same node it still runs first and its preventDefault() makes the guard skip the click. The window keeps that true whatever registers first (the relationship-list icons were caught by exactly this order, docs/claude/artwork-caa-eaa.md).

name: sl image card: the shared record not shared
why: The card reads the detail preview's record (_dpMem); a provider map of its own would ask twice.
